variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ossian of the Drowned Lantern, Dunstan the smith, Mabry of the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: Pick yer pint! What'll it be fer ye?

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: Sorry, stranger, but my racks are a bit bare today. Bandits on the road tend to make folks buy up every blade in town. Heh, heh...

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: Word gets around quick. Buy something, before I turn you into a newt!

variants.specifics: Varrhold: Grobbin keeps the tavern, Kettrick the forge, Mizzra the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Grobbin
inn.text: Sorry friend, the miners have drunk me dry! I haven't a drop of ale left to pour you.

arms.speaker: Kettrick
arms.text: Anyone who fights the dead is welcome at my forge. What can I get you?

magic.speaker: Mizzra
magic.text: Topsiders aren't trusted in my shop. But for a few coins more, I'll look the other way.

variants.specifics: Skeel: Bettik keeps the inn, Durgan sells arms and armor, Zeela sells potions and scrolls.

inn.speaker: Bettik
inn.text: Wanna try the stew? The turnips are snuck in by barge from the big farms over in Corvale.

arms.speaker: Durgan
arms.text: Something tells me we're going to get along just fine! As long as you keep on buying, that is!

magic.speaker: Zeela
magic.text: Haven't had many shoppers lately. Skeel isn't anybody's idea of a holiday right now, what with Zombies climbing the ladders every night.

variants.specifics: Gorst: Bodkin keeps the inn, Krugg the smith runs Blades Galore, Old Fenna sells potions and books.

inn.speaker: Bodkin
inn.text: Well... Perhaps not the softest beds in Gorst... But damn cheap all the same!

arms.speaker: Krugg
arms.text: Welcome to Blades Galore. I reckon I may have a sword or two lying about.

magic.speaker: Old Fenna
magic.text: You're a bold one, poking your nose into Gorst with the Undead at our gates.

variants.specifics: Ombry: Dabbo keeps the inn, Krell the arms shop, Yselde the potion and scroll shop.

inn.speaker: Dabbo
inn.text: I hope you'll be wanting a bed tonight, stranger. You look like you rowed across the whole lake to get here.

arms.speaker: Krell
arms.text: Are you a new recruit for the harbor watch?

magic.speaker: Yselde
magic.text: You look a little green around the gills, friend.

variants.specifics: Merinth: Bartholo keeps the inn, Gorm the arms shop, Zinnia the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Bartholo
inn.text:
A stranger, eh? The Masters up at the College look down on your kind, but they've never been past the town gate and I have! What do they know!? Ha! Heh, heh, heh...

Your coin is welcome here anytime, sir.

arms.speaker: Gorm
arms.text: Sorry, I don't sell to students.

magic.speaker: Zinnia
magic.text:
Wanna try a new potion?

I call it 'Zorvan's Downfall.'

variants.specifics: Fort Vosk: Brodd the innkeeper, Gundar the smith, Zenka who sells potions and scrolls.

inn.speaker: Brodd
inn.text: Keep out, stranger! I don't rent rooms to ZOMBIES!

arms.speaker: Gundar
arms.text: Greetings, stranger. I'm about to pack up my anvil and head down the mountain. All my stock is cheap, if you want it.

magic.speaker: Zenka
magic.text: Mind the ice while you're in Fort Vosk, young sir! I've got a whole shelf of potions here for broken bones.

variants.specifics: Durgal: Rudgar of the Hot Coal inn, Krenshaw the armourer, Mirva who sells potions and spell books.

inn.speaker: Rudgar
inn.text: You can't be back here, stranger. Rooms are round the front of the Hot Coal.

arms.speaker: Krenshaw
arms.text: You'd better be quick I've got a sword in the fire.

magic.speaker: Mirva
magic.text: Pssst! Back here! You in want of a spell book? A potion or two, perhaps?

variants.specifics: Pellor's Cross: Fennick of the Four Roads Inn, Dagny the smith, Mother Quill the potion-seller.

inn.speaker: Fennick
inn.text: Pssst! Hey! You! Want a room? Lowest price for miles and the pies are baked by my own mother up at Hamley Farm!

arms.speaker: Dagny
arms.text: Ogres ate my pony. Buy a sword?

magic.speaker: Mother Quill
magic.text: I hear you're off after Bludgor. Good luck, stranger!

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK general-purpose agent, Claude Opus 5.5

variants.specifics: Vellin: Brunna at the inn takes the player for an Ogre in the dark, Grudd the smith grumbles about the harvest, Ozzrik the potion seller frets about the Ogres.

inn.speaker: Brunna
inn.text: Stay back, you OGRE! Before I fetch my pitchfork!

arms.speaker: Grudd
arms.text: Trade's been poor this week, what with the harvest coming in and all.

magic.speaker: Ozzrik
magic.text: Hard times, lad. I can't believe Mayor Bodrick let the Ogres get so close to town. Dark days indeed! Best buy your potions now, before they're gone!
